source: Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana, Vat.lat.3677, first foliation f17v
scope: All ten lowest five-child parents, both five-parent upper nodes and the page root. No Voynich data.
method: Native visual reading of full page and three original-resolution IIIF regions. No OCR, enhancement, transcription model or full-word recovery. Onsets read from child positions; uncertainty retained. Case-insensitive prefix compatibility is weaker than fixed first-syllable clipping. Prefix witnesses selected after reading parent, so this is existential source collation, not a prospective clipping prediction.
prior_exposure: Root saw producer topology and first-parent example before collation. Other-page collation was not opened. Not blind source discovery or independent semantic confirmation.

nodes.note: First group reread at original-resolution region; no complete leaf expansion asserted.
Case ignored for comparison; chosen Ba is a prefix of Bambu, not a proved phonological syllable.
Limu onset and parent lim allow an ordered prefix, without proving syllable clipping.
U-shaped initial forms are displayed with U/u; no claim about classical lexical spelling.
Second leaf position carries only a stub-like character. Do not expand it to do from the parent. First onset also uncertain. Five bracketed positions are not five fully read compounds.
Surface onset witnesses only, not all four component names.
Dal and Pla are observable prefixes; phonological first-syllable identity is unverified.
Final child onset and parent ending are uncertain. Do not impose G-to-C normalization to manufacture equality.
Both Amucamafe=A+Mu+Ca+Ma+Fe and Ammucamafe=Am+Mu+Ca+Ma+Fe are prefix-compatible. This does not choose the reading or a phonological clipping rule.
Full word tails remain outside this onset collation.
Visible second-component letter is p-like; b would allow Tri+ba+le+ca+do, p would contradict literal concatenation of P02. No b/p equivalence authorized.
Compatible intended candidate Ua+Stri+Se+Am+Ca is not accepted as a diplomatic reading from its expected construction. Preserve possible extra medial letter.
Both upper-node uncertainties lie after the directly visible prefixes consumed by the root.

conclusion: Eight unambiguous prefix-compatible nodes, one compatible under retained reading alternatives, four unresolved. Some unresolved readings would be literal counterexamples; no all-node strict-law pass. Hierarchical ownership is visible, but a universal clipping rule and complete word expansions remain unverified.
reopening: Resolve actual source readings and writer commitments before selecting a strict target contract. Do not infer missing child text from parent or introduce b/p repairs.
claim_ceiling: Historical source mechanism only; zero Voynich meanings, no target tree, no decoder selection.
